importantDecisions: Requirement statuses are re-derived from artifacts after every build (collect + merge): a resolution whose consuming stage was rebuilt but whose gap persists stays UNRESOLVED — bookkeeping can never fake readiness.

PRODUCTION_READY gate is artifact-derived only: indexable production spec + zero unresolved release-blocking requirements + PASSING isolated-package QA + fresh production stage. A domain alone flips the SEO plan mode but BLOCKS the production stage while blockers remain (preflight R3).

accepted-limitation (acknowledgements) deliberately does NOT unlock indexable production for release-blocking requirements (spec §7: blockers must be resolved) — stripe's inline-SVG mark blocker therefore cannot be acknowledged away.

severity policy encoded once (SEVERITY_POLICY) as a transcription of spec §19: og-image/organization-logo/business-facts are high-value (not §19 conditions), social handle optional, everything §19 names is release-blocking; replacement-recommended assets downgrade to high-value unless they still render from source (residual escalation).

applyAssetResolutions is the release-layer consumer of the Task 22 record-only replacement seam (preflight R1): derives a NEW materialization run (media content-hashed, rewrite map extended, entries flipped to provided, font-decisions.json recorded); inherited network/font QA reports carry a derivation note and stale-census warnings (conservative, never fake-better).
Frozen stages (reconstruction/template) have NO runners at all; release:build refuses on their input drift — unnecessary re-reconstruction is structurally impossible, not just untested.

release:build reuses ONLY public typed APIs (prepareContentRun/ingestGenerationResult, createThemeRun, createProductionSeoPlanRun, runProductionCompile/runProductionQa) — zero subprocess, zero algorithm duplication.
projectId is deterministic (<host>-<specRunId>) so re-prepare is idempotent; requirement ids are deterministic (artifact discriminators) so identity survives re-collection.

Indexable-path sitemap fix in src/production/run.ts was required (Task 23 gap: production-mode compile crashed on missing sitemap.preview.xml and QA demanded a served /sitemap.xml); additive, preview path byte-identical, smoke:production count unchanged (84).
knownLimitations: og-image / organization-logo / social-handle resolutions are recorded, matched and shipped in media/, but the SEO plan has no consumption seam for them yet (named seam; requirements are high-value/optional so honesty is preserved).

Derived materialization runs inherit report/network-qa.json + font-qa.json from the base run (conservative direction; derivation note written; collect warns when an inherited census lists a provided asset as residual). Re-measurement = re-run assets:qa against the derived run.

The release graph follows spec §12: content reruns do not invalidate the asset inventory, so replacement-manifest slotKey/imageBrief joins may reference the earlier content run (recorded as a project limitation).

fontDecisions 'self-host-license-verified' records the decision but no font-fetch machinery exists (Task 22 never fetches fonts); 'use-fallback-stack' matches the measured fallback reality. Layout-QA is not re-run on a font decision (the fallback is exactly what font-qa measured); noted via warnings.
Production build-dir freshness tracks the spec dir hash (1 file); the 60MB+ build directory itself is not re-hashed on every plan (QA report inside it is read directly).

The fixture's initial materialization network-qa.json is a hand-built zero-residual fixture (assets:qa is browser-measured); the REAL authority in the fixture is the production QA census, independently asserting 0 external requests.
